class.name: VoxelBrushSphere
class.description: A [VoxelBrushSphere] cuts and fills a sphere centered on the brush's origin. It is the simplest and cheapest brush, and the one to reach for first: rotation cannot change it, its falloff is even in every direction, and dragged along a path it leaves a round-bottomed channel.

members.member: The radius of the sphere, in the same units as the field it is stamped into. A radius below the field's [member VoxelField.voxel_size] cannot cut a hole the field is able to store.
